title: Amnesty
summary: AM'NESTY, noun [Gr. of a neg and memory, from the root of mens, mind. See Mind.] An act of oblivion; a general pardon of the offenses of subjects against the government, or the proclamation of such pa

inlines.v: AM'NESTY, noun [Gr. of a neg and memory, from the root of mens, mind. See Mind.] An act of oblivion; a general pardon of the offenses of subjects against the government, or the proclamation of such pardon.
